question: Regarding the tendon reflex of Golgi:

options.opb: The receptors are in series with the extrafusal muscle fibers.
options.opc: It is mediated by afferent fibers type la and ll.
options.opd: Activates α-motor neurons that innervate the muscle in which the receptor is located.
options.ope: It is very sensitive to changes in muscle length.
